candidates.intent_rationale: Riders hear constant honking and want to know when the law actually allows the horn, the night-time ban in residential areas and what continuous honking costs.
candidates.content_angle: Explains Article 21 of Law 36/2024/QH15 (horn only to warn of danger or announce overtaking, no continuous honking, no horn from 22:00 to 05:00 in residential and hospital areas), headlight signalling at night under Article 14(5), and the Decree 168/2024 fines in Article 7(1)(i) and 7(9)(k).

candidates.primary_query: hoeveel personen op een scooter in vietnam
secondary_queries: met drie op een scooter vietnam boete
kind achterop de scooter in vietnam
regels voor passagiers scooter vietnam
candidates.intent_rationale: Couples, families and groups want to know how many people may ride one motorbike in Vietnam and whether children count before deciding how many bikes to rent.
candidates.content_angle: Explains Article 33(1) of Law 36/2024/QH15 (one passenger, at most two only for a sick person going to emergency care, a person under arrest, a child under 12 or an elderly or disabled person), helmet duties for everyone on board and the Decree 168/2024 fine in Article 7(2)(g).
candidates.working_title: Hoeveel personen mogen er op een scooter in Vietnam?
